[[Wikipedia:Linköping|Linköping]], [[Wikipedia:Östergötland County|Östergötland County]], [[Wikipedia:Sweden|Sweden]] |death= |listedpronouns= |nationality=[[Wikipedia:Swedes|Swedish]] |occupation=*Composer{{DisneyGallery|Score}} *Arranger *Musician *Songwriter *Record producer |companies=*[[Wikipedia:Roc Nation|Roc Nation]] *[[Wikipedia:Glassnote Records|Glassnote Records]] *[[Wikipedia:Island Records|Island Records]] *[[Wikipedia:Interscope Records|Interscope Records]] |website= }} {{Quote|[Ludwig Göransson] doesn't necessarily have a signature style musically. His music adjusts to each story, and as a filmmaker that's really compelling. ''[…]'' He's able to collaborate in many, many different worlds and many media. He has already proven at his young age that he knows how to connect with people—not just the people he's collaborating with but audiences and listeners.|[[Jon Favreau]]|{{WebCite|url=https://www.latimes.com/lifestyle/story/2019-11-01/composer-ludwig-goransson-music-sounds-black-panther-disney-star-wars-mandalorian|text=‘Black Panther’ composer Ludwig Göransson brings new sounds to ‘Star Wars’ series ‘The Mandalorian’|author=Marques Harper|date=2019-11-01|archivedate=20230304001934}}}} '''Ludwig Göransson''' (born [[September 1]], [[1984]]) is an [[Wikipedia:Academy Awards|Academy Award]] and [[Wikipedia:Grammy Award|Grammy Award]]–winning [[Wikipedia:Swedes|Swedish]] film composer and record producer. He is best known for writing and producing alongside [[Donald Glover|Childish Gambino]] and for composing the musical scores of [[Wikipedia:Fruitvale Station|''Fruitvale Station'']], [[Wikipedia:Creed (film)|''Creed'']], and [[Wikipedia:Black Panther (film)|''Black Panther'']], which received an [[Wikipedia:Academy Award for Best Original Score|Academy Award for Best Original Score]].{{WebCite|url=https://oscar.go.com/nominees|text=Oscar Nominations 2019|work=[https://oscar.go.com The Oscars 2019]|archivedate=20200729190842}} He composed the musical score of the first two seasons of the [[Disney+]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''.{{SW|url=news/ludwig-goransson-to-compose-score-for-the-mandalorian|text=Ludwig Göransson to Compose Score for ''The Mandalorian''}} In [[2020]], he was awarded [[Wikipedia:Outstanding Music Composition for a Series|Outstanding Music Composition for a Series]] in the [[Wikipedia:72nd Primetime Creative Arts Emmy Awards|2020 Primetime Creative Arts Emmy Awards]] for his work on "[[Chapter 8: Redemption]]." Ludwig also won the Academy Award for Best Original Score in 2024 for [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oppenheimer_(film) Oppenheimer].[https://limelight-arts.com.au/news/ludwig-goransson-wins-oscar-for-best-score/ ''Ludwig Göransson wins Oscar for best score''.
